summary: Iteration 71: Tested admin cancel-with-reason audit and status tabs in orders panel. All features working correctly. Backend cancel endpoint accepts {reason, notes}, stores cancellation_notes + cancelled_by='admin', fires customer email (kind=order_cancellation_customer) + internal event (kind=internal_order_cancelled). Status tabs render with count badges and filter orders client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend is lenient - accepts 'other' reason with empty notes (frontend enforces required notes for 'other')
Order document stores: cancellation_reason, cancellation_notes, cancelled_by='admin', cancelled_at
send_order_cancellation_email fires to customer with human-readable reason
fire_internal_event(ORDER_CANCELLED) fires to INTERNAL_RECIPIENTS (Deepak, ankush, accounts, animesh @locofast.com)
Internal email correctly NOT sent to customer email - verified in email_logs
Credit refund flow works when payment_method=credit and payment_status=paid
Status tabs (data-testid='admin-order-status-tabs') render all 9 statuses with count badges
Cancel modal (data-testid='cancel-modal') has 4 reason radios + notes textarea (data-testid='admin-cancel-notes')
Cancel button in detail modal (data-testid='admin-cancel-order-modal-btn') visible when order is NOT cancelled/delivered
